---
title: "Design matrix 2-norm condition number per tissue"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Overview

For each tissue, the maSigPro polynomial regression design matrix (`design_mat.csv`) is loaded
from the latest dated subdirectory containing `maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3/` (exact name match).
The 2-norm condition number is computed as κ₂ = σ_max / σ_min via `kappa(..., exact = TRUE)`.

---

## 1. Settings

```{r settings}
wd_mrna  <- "F:/wd/Mm_Bulk_RNA-seq"
tissues  <- c("bat", "ewat", "gas", "gut", "hypo", "iwat", "liver", "panc", "sol")
```

---

## 2. Find design_mat.csv (latest maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3)

```{r find_csv}
find_design_mat <- function(tis, wd_mrna) {
  base  <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tis)
  # Collect all design_mat.csv inside exact maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3 subdirectories
  all_files <- list.files(base, pattern = "^design_mat\\.csv$",
                          recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  # Keep only paths with exact directory name maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3
  hits <- all_files[grepl("/maSigPro_rsq0\\.7_d3/", all_files)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NULL)
  # Extract dates and return the path from the latest date
  dates <- regmatches(hits, regexpr("\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}", hits))
  hits[which.max(as.Date(dates))]
}

paths_df <- tibble(tissue = tissues) %>%
  mutate(path = map_chr(tissue, ~ {
    p <- find_design_mat(.x, wd_mrna)
    if (is.null(p)) NA_character_ else p
  }))

paths_df %>%
  mutate(found = !is.na(path)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

---

## 3. Compute 2-norm condition number

```{r compute_kappa}
compute_kappa <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path)) return(NA_real_)
  X <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1)
  X_mat <- as.matrix(X)
  kappa(X_mat, exact = TRUE)
}

kappa_df <- paths_df %>%
  mutate(
    kappa2       = map_dbl(path, compute_kappa),
    date         = regmatches(path, regexpr("\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}", path)),
    n_rows       = map_int(path, ~ if (is.na(.x)) NA_integer_ else nrow(read.csv(.x, row.names = 1))),
    n_cols       = map_int(path, ~ if (is.na(.x)) NA_integer_ else ncol(read.csv(.x, row.names = 1)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, date, n_rows, n_cols, kappa2)

kappa_df %>% print(n = Inf)
```

---

## 4. Summary

```{r summary_table}
summary_stats <- kappa_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(kappa2)) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean     = mean(kappa2),
    sd       = sd(kappa2),
    min      = min(kappa2),
    max      = max(kappa2)
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "2-norm condition number (n = %d tissues)\n  mean ± SD : %.2f ± %.2f\n  range     : %.2f – %.2f\n",
  summary_stats$n,
  summary_stats$mean, summary_stats$sd,
  summary_stats$min,  summary_stats$max
))
```

---

## 5. Per-tissue table

```{r per_tissue_table}
kappa_df %>%
  arrange(kappa2) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "2-norm condition number per tissue")
```

---

## 6. Barplot

```{r barplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
kappa_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(kappa2)) %>%
  mutate(tissue = fct_reorder(tissue, kappa2)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tissue, y = kappa2)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = summary_stats$mean, linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "2-norm condition number of maSigPro design matrix",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = mean (%.1f)", summary_stats$mean),
    x = "Tissue", y = expression(kappa[2])
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  file.path(wd_mrna, "output", "design_mat_condition_number_20260515.png"),
  width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 150
)
```
